author: Jim-purch
description: A multi-person interactive relationship exploration and mutual inspiration dialogue guide skill. Supports couples dialogue, friends exploration, parent-child dialogue modes. When users want to engage in couples/partners dialogue, friend exploration, relationship games, shared topics, psychological Q&A, card conversations, deep chats, or intimate relationship exercises, trigger this skill immediately. Also applicable when users say 'I want to play a game with you', 'help me and my friend/partner do an interaction', 'I want to deeply understand the other person'. Requires two or more participants.
name: soul-mirror-with-other
